description: This file defines a composable function SafeColumn, which acts as a no-operation container for UI layout, simply invoking its content without applying any layout container, to avoid certain Compose IR lowering issues. It is intended for use in a Jetpack Compose UI environment to handle spacing and alignment through child Modifiers.

methods.name: SafeColumn
methods.description: A no-op composable container that invokes its content directly, passing through Modifiers and avoiding layout containers to mitigate IR lowering failures.
